title: Claude Code Hooks: Log a Trace of Every Agent Run
description:
Your AI agent says "I fixed it". Can you prove what it did? ✅

✅ Add a PostToolUse hook in .claude/settings.json
✅ Append every tool call to trace.jsonl
✅ List the tools it used with one jq command

Day 7 of Agent Harness. Next up: Day 8, Cap Agent Loops with Step Limits.
Follow for a new short every day and build AI agents you can trust.

comment: Bash or Edit: which tool would you trace first? Tell me in a word! Extra tip: add trace.jsonl to .gitignore so your logs never end up in a commit.
